Rhea (Sales Eng): Quick: Polaris sent an RFP. They want a 14-day POC in their US VPC, baseline 3 GPUs, burst to 7, SOC2, KMIP HSM option, and a capability matrix mapped to their control IDs. Need non-binding pricing + config snippet by EOD.

Derek (AE): Understood. Do they insist on customer-managed certs for mTLS and 90-day audit retention?

Rhea (Sales Eng): Yes to certs, retention negotiable up to 90 days. Include clause for US-only processing and 30-day log deletion for PII by default.

Omar (SRE): Private POC doable. ETA ~48h for peering + basic nodes. HSM integration adds 7+ days and SOW. Minimal bootstrap for their infra:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://peering.redwood.ai/agent/bootstrap -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" | sudo bash -s -- --env polaris-poc --cidr 10.77.0.0/22
```
Need contact + CIDR + desired burst windows.

Claire (Solutions): Uploading polaris_matrix_v1.xlsx and polaris_rfi_answers_v1.pdf. Matrix calls out model catalog, quant profiles, KV caching, routing/fallbacks, observability, and per-route SLAs. SOC2 redacted attached.

Derek (AE): Pricing suggestion: 50% off compute for first 14 days + waive onboarding. Omar, ballpark non-binding?

Omar (SRE): 3xA100-eq reserved ~ $13k/mo; burst ~$15/GPU-hr; egress ~$0.09/GB. With promo estimate ~$1.7k - $2.5k depending on burst. HSM + certs add fees and lead time.

attest-bot: SOC2 Type II (redacted) attached.

Rhea (Sales Eng): I'll assemble the RFP reply with attachments and the non-binding quote. Derek, approve promo?

Derek (AE): Approved. Send with trial limits: 14 days, max burst 7 GPUs, trial support tier.
